name: video-frame-grabber
description: Grab still frames from a video and make a contact sheet. Find a frame at every cut or slide change (scene detection, tuned for camera footage or for slides and screen recordings), or take one every N seconds, or N frames spread evenly. Every frame is a row you can move by editing its time, label, untick, or add at exact moments. Black frames from fades, near-duplicates and times past the end are flagged. Exports the frames as JPG or PNG (named by video, number, time and label), a contact-sheet PNG with timestamps and a CSV list. Runs locally with ffmpeg; no account or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 从视频里截取画面并做成小样图。可以按场景变化截取（每次换镜头或换幻灯片取一张，拍摄素材、幻灯片和录屏都能调），也可以每隔 N 秒截一张，或者平均截 N 张。每一帧是一行，改时间就能挪位置，可以加标签、取消勾选，或者在指定时间点加一帧。淡入淡出时的黑帧、几乎重复的帧、超出视频结尾的时间都会提示。导出 JPG 或 PNG 图片（按视频名、序号、时间和标签命名）、带时间码的小样图 PNG，以及 CSV 帧列表。在本地用 ffmpeg 运行，不用登录，无需 API 密钥。
